# CardInfo

Figma: [07d. CardInfo](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-945) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The informational / guidance card: a circular badge (icon or avatar) + title + description + chevron, themed by tone. Use it for help prompts, advisor cards, tips and status info. Type (Icon / Avatar) × Tone (Brand · Info · Success · Warning · Error · Neutral) × Direction.

### CardInfo

Standalone informational card with a circular icon or advisor avatar badge, title, description and chevron, themed by tone. Used for help prompts, relationship-manager cards, tips and status notes that tap through.

Level: organism · Contains: CardInfo / Content, Avatar

Use when:
- Help card (Type=Icon, Tone=Brand) such as 'Need any help with your investments?'
- Relationship manager or advisor card (Type=Avatar)
- Persistent status notes such as identity verified (Tone=Success) or document needed (Tone=Warning)

Don't use when:
- Transient or severity messages: use Toast, Alert or Banner
- A CTA with a button: use ActionPrompt
- A row inside a settings list: use ListItem
- Deals: use CardDeal

Accessibility: Whole card is one link or button; tone carried by the text; avatar alt is the person's name or decorative if named in the title.

| Tone | `tone` | variant | Brand, Info, Success, Warning, Error, Neutral | Brand |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

CardInfo communicates information or guidance as a standalone card - a help prompt, an advisor/relationship-manager card, a tip, or a status note. It pairs a circular badge (a swappable icon, or a person avatar) with a title and description and a trailing chevron, all themed by tone. For one-line severity messages use Alert / Toast / Banner instead.

### Atomic architecture

CardInfo composes the CardInfo / Content atom (title + description) with a leading badge - a swappable Syntropy Icon or an Avatar - and a chevron. The card border, badge, icon and text all derive from the tone.

Content (atom)

Icon (swap)

Avatar

Chevron

### Types

Icon - a swappable Syntropy icon in a tinted badge (help, tips, status). Avatar - a person photo (advisor / relationship-manager cards).

Icon

Avatar

### Tones

Six tones theme the whole card (border, badge, icon, text): Brand for help/relationship, Info/Success/Warning/Error for status, Neutral for plain notes.

Brand

Info

Success

Warning

Error

Neutral

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Mirrors fully: the badge moves to the leading (right) edge, text right-aligns with Arabic, and the chevron points inward.

### Code examples

Flutter usage of CardInfo.

### Icon card (help)

```dart
SafqahCardInfo(
  type: CardInfoType.icon,
  tone: CardInfoTone.brand,
  icon: SafqahIcons.headset,
  title: 'Need any help with your investments?',
  description: 'Our team is ready for a private conversation.',
  onTap: () => context.push('/support'),
)
```

### Avatar card (advisor, tone)

```dart
SafqahCardInfo(
  type: CardInfoType.avatar,
  tone: CardInfoTone.warning,
  avatar: NetworkImage(advisor.photoUrl),
  title: 'Your advisor needs you',
  description: 'Abdullah is waiting on a document to proceed.',
  onTap: () => context.push('/advisor'),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use CardInfo for help, advisor and status info - one idea, the whole card taps through via the chevron.

Don’t

Don’t use CardInfo for transient or severity alerts - use Toast / Banner / Alert (05a–05c) instead.

Do

Match the tone to meaning - Success for done, Warning when the user must act, Neutral for plain notes.

Don’t

Don’t overuse Error/Warning tones or pile on copy - keep CardInfo to a single scannable message.
